title: Particle AE-GAN Multimodal Reconstruction & Generation
intuition: Combines particle-AE reconstruction with adversarial generation on 4 corner Gaussians, requiring both accurate held-out reconstruction (recon_mse <= 0.025) and faithful independent sampling (4/4 modes, precision >= 0.90).
failure_mode: Adversarial updates destabilize the autoencoder latent geometry, or reconstruction dominates and leaves prior samples off-manifold.
